operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Kills Hamas Gaza Military Wing Chief al-Haddad in Gaza City on Day 948 / Day 6 of Renewed Campaign
heroSubtitle: Israeli airstrikes on May 16, 2026 (Day 948 of the war; Day 6 of the renewed military campaign authorized May 10) killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad, identified by the IDF as the head of Hamas's Gaza military wing — the most significant Hamas military leadership strike since Mohammed Sinwar's killing on May 13, 2026 (Day 945). Two strikes hit a residential building and then al-Haddad's vehicle in Gaza City; 7 were killed and dozens wounded (treated at Saraya Field Hospital and Al-Shifa Hospital). Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz both publicly confirmed the operation. The IDF also confirmed the recent killings of three additional Hamas operatives in northern and central Gaza. Israel's political landscape shifted further as a Knesset dissolution bill progressed — elections are now scheduled by October 27, 2026. The cumulative Palestinian death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen past 72,760+ killed (880+ since the October 2025 ceasefire). Hamas's internal succession process, triggered by Mohammed Sinwar's death, continues with Khalil al-Hayya and Khaled Mashaal as frontrunners for the new Hamas chief position. IDF Orange Line controls ~64% of Gaza Strip. Humanitarian access: ~110 trucks/day vs. 600+ required; 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, under 10% funded.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, IMEMC, NPR, OCHA, Just Security. Gaza death toll: 72,760+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (WAFA/IMEMC, May 16, 2026). 880+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. Day 6 (May 16): Hamas Gaza military wing chief Izz al-Din al-Haddad killed in IDF airstrike, Gaza City — 7 killed, dozens wounded. Day 5 (May 15 / Nakba Day 78): UNSC debate SC16284; Hamas succession begins. Day 3 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar killed. UNRWA staff killed: 391. IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Orange Line = 64% of Gaza Strip. ICC admissibility challenge rejected. Knesset dissolution → elections by Oct 27, 2026. Day 948 of war.
